title: How To Crochet Modern Granny Blanket in Many Sizes + Tutorials (2024 Updated Version - Square Size)
author: The Crochet Crowd
notes: Only the '2024 Updated Version - Square Size' section is transcribed: 3-dc granny rounds alternating with (sc, ch 3) net rounds. The rectangle (foundation chain) version, materials and border are omitted. start: original 'With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to form ring.' replaced by magic ring. Headings '1st rnd:' etc. normalised to 'Round N:'. Rnds 3, 4, 5 and 7 say 'then from * to ** once more' but the page has no '**'; the DSL works 4 corners in all, as the round shape requires. 'Miss next 2 dc. 1 sc between next 2 dc' puts the sc in the gap between 3-dc groups (sc@sp). Stitch graph: round 6 reads badly (cost 20.0); check where its stitches go.
